matchups.title: Section 2A: Play vs. Draw & Turn Pacing Performance
rows: Simic holds +16.0% overall matchup advantage across 1,000 simulated games
Simic maintains high win rate when taking the first turn
Simic maintains win rate stability on the draw via land search & 3-toughness blockers
Simic closes out ~1 turn faster once 6+ CMC stompy threats resolve

matchups.title: Section 2B: Combat Damage, Lifegain & Resource Cumulative Totals (1,000 Matches)
rows: Averages ~3.94 direct burn points per game (Shock, Open Fire, Soul Burn, Agonizing Syphon)
Witty Roastmaster & General Kreat ETB pings bypass ground blockers
Obscura Storefront (2x), Riveteers Overlook & Social Climber lifegain
Extended mid-game combat pacing with frequent creature trades

matchups.title: Section 2C: Key Card Synergy & Trigger Analytics
rows: Game-ending: Drops three 6/6 Wurms; Rakdos single-target removal cannot deal with multiple 6/6s
Overkills 1-2 toughness blockers to generate Jace loyalty card draw engine
Offsets Rakdos self-damage while keeping Simic in burn range

matchups.title: Section 2D: Strategic Matchup Takeaways & Turn Threshold Dynamics
rows: Rakdos wins 78% of games if Simic is reduced below 8 life by Turn 5. If Simic reaches Turn 6 with >10 life, Simic's win rate jumps to 84%.
Rakdos must aggressively push early damage; Simic must prioritize defensive blockers & lifegain.
Rakdos pre-combat removal (Strangle, Shock, Agonizing Demise) clearing early dorks gives Rakdos 6-9 damage combat swings.
Simic should use Slip Out the Back to protect key ramp threats like Quandrix Cultivator.
Classic Aggro/Burn vs. Inevitability Ramp. Simic's high creature density and land filtering neutralize Rakdos ground attacks late.
Balanced casual matchup suitable for casual play testing.
